_readme: Audit log for roadmap.html - the header version badge and its modal render from this file. Newest first; dates are UTC ISO-8601. Append an entry with a semver bump for any change that alters what the roadmap page shows (see AGENTS.md, Key files).

changes: Local audit lane, revised on first live use (@jwildfire): ✓/✗ now stage decisions into a queue instead of firing an agent per click — a queue bar shows the staged batch, nothing runs until an explicit submit, clicks toggle, and the queue survives reloads (D2 revised for the local lane; the D3 mute-confirm moved to submit time).
Submit hands the whole batch to one spawned agent; several submits can run concurrently — the global page lock is gone (locks are per finding), and the run panel keeps one line per in-flight submit.
The deployed read-only page is unchanged in behavior; both views build from the same source.

The audit page no longer deals in tokens (@jwildfire). The deployed copy is now strictly read-only: the connect-a-PAT dialog, localStorage token, and browser-side repository_dispatch are gone entirely — a public page holds no write path.

Deciding moves to the local session hub: the same page built with AUDIT_MODE=local, where ✓/✗ POST finding ids to the loopback hub server, which spawns a local Claude Code agent to run the apply lane (fresh-audit re-validation, closed op vocabulary, outcomes re-read from the committed ledger — the #109 contract unchanged).
Filing an audit-decision issue remains the documented fallback lane; the roadmap-audit-apply workflow still serves it.
New Hierarchy section: the goal → requirement → task forest as an expandable tree built from live sub-issue links, with issues no goal can reach grouped separately as Orphans.

Two views: Current renders exactly what GitHub records; Proposed overlays the links in scripts/roadmap-proposal.json (badged, with reasoning) plus cleanup flags — the 2026-07-27 roadmap-cleanup session's re-organization, awaiting @jwildfire's review. Approved links get applied as real sub-issue relationships, and the two views converge.
jwildfire/open.csr joined scripts/status-repos.csv — it was missing from the portfolio list, so the roadmap page's collectors (PRs, hierarchy, news, metrics, status) never saw the CSR builder's repo.

The morning review guide (#114) piloted the checkbox-driven review flow: each checked box triggered the mapped merge/release/action with a posted confirmation — the lane the audit's apply loop now shares.
Board note: stages for the newly closed requirements were deliberately left for the audit pilot to sweep.

New Audit section (requirement #92): a nightly rule sweep of the roadmap's own conventions, collapsed by default, listing every finding with its evidence, a high/medium/low confidence, and a specific proposed change.

Accept and Reject on every finding. Accept opens a prefilled decision issue; the apply lane re-validates the finding against a fresh audit, then applies it — mechanical fixes as a closed vocabulary of operations, judgment calls through a bounded agent. Rejections change nothing and mute the finding for 60 days, or until its evidence changes.

New collapsed rule list: all 22 rules with what each checks, why the convention exists, how a violation is fixed, and whether the rule is firing, quiet, skipped or broken — so an empty findings list can be told apart from an audit that could not run.
The deploy now fails if the roadmap page loses its audit section or the findings ledger goes missing.

Session indicator now reports its own staleness: past two hours without an update the pill stops asserting a live state and reads 'session feed last updated Nh ago' in a dashed, muted style. The publisher is a Stop hook that must never break a session, so it can only fail quietly — showing a confident '2 working' from a feed that died hours ago is worse than showing nothing

Deploy validation names the page and the missing content when it fails, instead of exiting 1 silently, and no longer asserts a specific goal-page filename (a goal rename took a deploy down on 8cd5314)
